articles.text: JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Nín hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
EXHIBIT GUIDE: Do you have any more questions?
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Yǒu yíge xiǎo wèntí. Shànghǎide jīqì fǎngzhī gōngyè shi shénme shíhou kāishǐde?
AMERICAN: I have one small question. When did Shànghǎi's machine textile industry first come into being?
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Hěn zǎo yǐqián jiù yǒule.
EXHIBIT GUIDE: It started a long time ago.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Nàme, zhème duō nián lái, zài jìshu fāngmiànde fāzhǎn shi bu shi hěn kuài ne?
AMERICAN: Well, over all these years, has the technological development been very rapid?
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Wǒ xiǎng chuántǒng fǎngzhī gōngyè fāzhǎnde bú màn, kěshi nílóng, huàxiān yílèide, fāzhǎnde bú gòu kuài.
EXHIBIT GUIDE: I'd say the traditional textile industry has developed rather rapidly, but such things as nylon and synthetic fibers haven't developed fast enough.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Wǒ tīngshuō, Zhōngguóde qīng gōngyè guòqù dōu zài yánhǎi, xiàng Tiānjīn, Shànghǎi, Guǎngdōng yídài. Xiànzài nèidìde qíngxing shi bu shi biànhuà yě hěn dà le ne?

AMERICAN: I understand that China's light industry used to be all on the coast, for example in the region of Tiānjīn, Shànghǎi, and Guǎngdōng. Has the situation in the interior also changed a great deal now?
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Shìde, gèdì qíngkuàng bù tóng, búguò yǒu yíge qíngkuàng shi gèdì dōu yǒude.
EXHIBIT GUIDE: Yes. The situation differs from place to place, but there's one thing that's the same everywhere.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Shénme qíngkuàng?
AMERICAN: What's that?
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Cóngqián shi nóngyèqūde dìfang, xiànzài yǒu hěn duō dōu fāzhǎnqilai le, yǒule qīng gōngyè, yǒude hái yǒule zhòng gōngyè.
EXHIBIT GUIDE: A lot of places that used to be agricultural regions have now started to develop, and have light industry, or even heavy industry.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Shì a! Jiāngsū yě shi yíyàng ma, dàde jīnshǔ gōngyè yě fāzhǎnqilai le.
AMERICAN: Yes! Jiāngsū is the same. A large metal industry has developed there.
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Zài guò jǐnián hǎiwān shíyóu gōngyè dà fāzhǎn, Shànghǎi, Tiānjīn, Guǎngdōng, Guǎngxī yídài jiù gèng rènào le.
EXHIBIT GUIDE: In another few years the gulf oil industry will develop greatly. Then Shànghǎi, Tiānjīn, Guǎngdōng, and Guǎngxī will be even busier.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Zhēnde, dào nèige shíhou, Shànghǎi jiù gèng piàoliang le. Wǒ yídìng yào zài lái cānguān.
AMERICAN: Really, when that time comes, Shànghǎi will be even prettier. I have to come back to visit it again.
JIǍNGJIĚYUÁN: Hǎo a! Huānyíng nín zài lái!
EXHIBIT GUIDE: Fine! You'll be most welcome!
